response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable geospatial domain expertise through GISCollective and Green Map projects, combined with senior-level experience operating distributed systems handling millions of requests at scale. However, the C++ requirement presents a significant concern—his last substantial C++ work was in 2015, and his recent career has focused on TypeScript/Node.js development. While his demonstrated ability to learn multiple languages and work across diverse domains is encouraging, he would require meaningful ramp-up to return to systems-level programming, making this a conditional candidate worth exploring.
strengths: Deep geospatial domain expertise through founding GISCollective and contributing to Green Map, demonstrating real-world experience with mapping and navigation platforms
Proven ability to operate and optimize distributed systems handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby, with experience in low-latency optimization and high-throughput microservices
Versatile engineer with demonstrated proficiency across multiple programming languages and a track record of rapidly mastering new technical domains
concerns: C++ skills significantly outdated—last major work in 2015, with recent 5+ years focused exclusively on TypeScript and Node.js rather than systems programming
No Rust experience and no recent engagement with low-level systems programming, data pipeline optimization, or distributed infrastructure work
Geospatial background focuses on data collection and platform development rather than routing algorithms, tile optimization, or real-time traffic integration
